sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 120 was established by Ordinance No. 16644, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 30, 1980. Ordinance No. 16644 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 16644 was amended by Resolution No. 81-2593, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 2, 1981; Resolution No. 84-1520, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 2, 1984; Ordinance No. 18327, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 18, 1984; Ordinance No. 18336, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 1, 1984; Ordinance No. 18582, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 13, 1985; Ordinance No. 18752, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 5, 1985; and Ordinance No. 21945, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 12, 1994. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16644; 18327; 18336; 18582; 18752; 21945; 25508; Res. Nos. 81-2593; 84-1520)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 120 is established on property generally located along the west line of Preston Road, northeast of Frankford Road. The size of PD 120 is approximately 50.3773 acres. (Ord. Nos. 16644; 18336; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-120.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. A conceptual plan approved by the city plan commission is labelled Exhibit 120A. (Ord. Nos. 18327; 18582; 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-120.105.DEVELOPMENT PLAN.
(a)A detailed development plan must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission for each phase of development.
(b)Development of the church use in Tract III must conform to the development plan (Exhibit 120B) approved by the city plan commission on December 16, 1993, which is attached to and made a part of Ordinance No. 16644, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 21945; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.106.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of any building permit, a subdivision plat approved by the city plan commission must be filed for record with the county clerk. If the plat contains a common area or communally-owned facility, a legal instrument establishing a plan for permanent care of the area and/or facility must also be submitted to and approved by the commission. The instrument must be submitted to the commission with the plat and approved as to legal form by the city attorney. (Ord. Nos. 18327; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-120.107.USES. The following are the only uses permitted in this PD:
(1)Tract I: Single-family detached dwellings.
(2)Tract II: Multiple-family uses.
(3)Tract III: Single-family detached dwellings and a church. (Ord. Nos. 18327; 25508)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-120.108.DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS. The following development standards apply to the uses in this PD:
(1)With the exception of the maximum permitted height of a structure, development of Tracts I and III must comply with the standards for a TH-1 Townhouse District .
(2)Development standards of Tract II must comply with the standards for an MF-1 Multiple-Family District. (Ord. Nos. 18582; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.109.DENSITY. Tract I is limited to 106 dwelling units. Tract II is limited to 256 dwelling units. Tract III is limited to 30 dwelling units. (Ord. Nos. 18582; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.110.HEIGHT. Maximum height for all structures on Tract II is 36 feet. Structures on Tracts I and III may not exceed 24 feet in height, except that the church sanctuary on Tract III may be built to a maximum height of 62 feet, and the remainder of the church building may be built to a height of 30 feet as shown on the elevation drawings (Exhibit 120C) that are attached to and made a part of Ordinance No. 16644, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 18752; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.111.PARKING. All parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 18327; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.112.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII, “Sign Regulations.” (Ord. Nos. 18327; 25508)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.113.LANDSCAPE PLAN. A detailed landscape plan must be submitted with the development plan for city plan commission approval. The plan must show all proposed water areas, berms, plantings, common areas, and other relevant landscaped areas. (Ord. Nos. 18327; 25508)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-120.114.PAVING.
(a)All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must be constructed in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18327; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.115.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development in this PD must comply with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18327; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.116.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there is full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 18327; 25508)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-120.117.ZONING MAP. PD 123 is located on Zoning Map No. AA-7. (Ord. Nos. 16644; 25508)
